field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: Only models actually invoked; [] for CPU/aggregation, mandated Qwen3.8 for every model task.
field_principles.arc_session_complete_score: Complete bounded receipt, independent of a win.
field_principles.completion_receipts: Raw completion hashes preserve every actual model response.
field_principles.cumulative_induction_rows: Deduplicate hashes without relabeling historical rows.
field_principles.demand_observation: Report observed demand and limitations over the exact denominator.
field_principles.duration_s: Measured monotonic work time; no padding or reclassification to evade a floor.
field_principles.execution_venue: Exactly host, kv260, gatemate or polarfire; the top-level orchestration here is host.
field_principles.experiment_id: Bind the terminal receipt to the V635 task identity.
field_principles.field_principles: Annotate actual values in this map; do not wrap arbitrary dictionaries as principle/value records.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Every blocked_* verdict names failed check, upstream, field, expected and observed value.
field_principles.gpu_receipts: Task-owned lease and correlated CUDA observations.
field_principles.historical_identity_receipt: Authenticate retained V635 artifacts and preserve their existing induction identities.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Use complete_ or complete: for completed findings; blocked_* for external absence. A failed acceptance gate forbids positive.
field_principles.inference_mode: Use live_gpu only when task-owned CUDA work was sampled.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Use the recognized literal for the work actually executed; custom free text caused the Exp7208 quarantine.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Match actual generation, load-only, CPU or aggregation work and its duration floor.
field_principles.model_identity_receipt: GGUF revision/hash, exact loader and tokenizer, and actual CUDA execution.
field_principles.model_invoked: True only for actual model execution; upstream model outputs are cached evidence.
field_principles.model_specs: Keep the actual resolved model beside the mandated model declaration.
field_principles.official_leaderboard_score_reported: This cumulative session is not an official submission.
field_principles.optional_source_receipts: Missing sibling output is visible and nonblocking.
field_principles.paired_efficacy_reported: False because the two new sessions are replication units, not causal arms.
field_principles.per_game_results: Raw banked progress and action counts.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Actual code, resource, identity and gate observations before expensive work.
field_principles.random_seed: Freeze random choices before reading held-out outcomes.
field_principles.registered_level_increment: A repeated known game cannot increment the solve registry.
field_principles.registry_reproduction_receipt: The evaluator confirms r11l was reproduced before launch.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hash exact source, inputs, settings and raw unit rows.
field_principles.rows: Per unit/arm/seed metric, error and abstention for every comparison; retain full denominators.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260911 and record actual UTC timestamps, never copy an upstream run date.
field_principles.runner_receipt: One model, runner choice, PID identity and cleanup.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Historical, new, excluded and accepted counts; target 10 remains cumulative.
field_principles.schema: A versioned schema lets cumulative consumers reject incompatible rows.
field_principles.session_receipt: The bounded child terminal state distinguishes zero evidence from no run.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Bind code, source documents, manifests and raw evidence to claims.
field_principles.status: Write a terminal artifact only when done or externally blocked; running checkpoints use a different path.
field_principles.submitted: The experiment must not alter or submit the live default.
field_principles.terminal_timestamp_utc: Record when this process built the terminal receipt in UTC.
field_principles.tool_induction_rows: Unique identities, call events, validity and terminal outcomes.
field_principles.verdict_class: Closed enum positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial. partial means unfinished own work only.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: True when correctness authority is reused as the verifier; independent code alone is not distinct authority.
